name: admin.conversations.setTeams
purpose: Set the workspaces in an Enterprise org that connect to a public or private channel.

channel_id.desc: The encoded channel_id to add or remove to workspaces.

team_id.desc: The workspace to which the channel belongs if the channel is a local workspace channel. Omit this argument if the channel is a cross-workspace or org-wide shared channel.

target_team_ids.desc: A comma-separated list of workspaces to which the channel should be shared. Not required if the channel is being shared org-wide.

org_channel.desc: True if channel has to be converted to an org channel.
